name: William Charles Henry
source:
Constable William Henry is responsible, righteous and extremely devoted to his duty.
He is a gifted polyglot and is knowledgable about the local culture.
Aside from being good at combat, William also has a knack for dealing with those unseen dangers lurking in the invisible world.
[From [url=https://marie-marie.itch.io/one-last-goodbye]itch.io[/url]]
